input: It has unfortunately become necessary to report a delay on the part of the supplier, amounting in total to 4 weeks, and it is important to be clear about where the responsibility for this delay lies. The cause sits firmly with the supplier rather than with anything on our own side: a stoppage on the supplier's casting line has held the affected castings back at the works, and the dispatch dates that were quoted when the order was placed have consequently slipped. Because the delay affects the very delivery around which the installation sequence was originally planned, the work in question must either wait or be reorganised around the missing castings. The mitigation that is proposed in response is to resequence the installation work, so that those packages which do not depend on the castings can proceed first, while the casting-dependent packages are held back until the delivery arrives. The procurement lead will own this resequencing, and will report progress to the project board at each review until the castings are received, at which point the held packages can be released back into the sequence in their planned order.
